obligations.statement: getStage1RetryReason returns null when the HANDLE_RESPONSE tool call carries the same JSON object emitted twice back to back.

source.quote: still parses normal single-object HANDLE_RESPONSE args

obligations.statement: getStage1RetryReason returns null for a HANDLE_RESPONSE tool call whose arguments are a single JSON object.
getStage1RetryReason returns 'malformed HANDLE_RESPONSE tool call' when the arguments hold two different JSON objects back to back.
getStage1RetryReason returns 'malformed HANDLE_RESPONSE tool call' when the HANDLE_RESPONSE arguments are not a JSON object, such as a JSON array, a JSON string, or prose followed by an object.
getStage1RetryReason returns 'empty completion' for an empty string.
getVoiceTurnSignalMetadata returns the voiceTurnSignal found at the top level of the message content ({ nextSpeaker: 'user' } gives { nextSpeaker: 'user' }).
getVoiceTurnSignalMetadata returns the voiceTurnSignal nested under content.metadata ({ agentShouldSpeak: false } gives { agentShouldSpeak: false }).
